newsitem.title: USA: U.S to sell $15 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills May 19.
newsitem.headline: U.S to sell $15 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills May 19.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $15 billion of three- and six-month bills on May 19 to pay down $5.425 billion as a total of $20.416 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on May 22. The three-month bills mature on August 21 and the six-month bills mature on November 20.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127942T0 and for the six-month bills is 9127945U4.
